The focus of this page is to provide ISRs visibility into their overall quarterly targets and progress.

IMPORTANT: To see results, please simulate a real ISR


Currently you will only see this view from a supervisors perspective meaning

  1. You will get a roll up and need to use the filters
  2. The layout is slightly different for ISRs as there will not be as much white space between tables


As it is still the start of a new quarter information in this report is from Q2.


Work is still being done on this section to include accordion style features that let you roll up and down the reports.


Finally we still need good report headers for MyDashard 1 and 2. Any suggestions are welcome


If you have issues accessing the report, please contact Dubey, Sankalp <sankalp.dubey@hp.com>

about actions","description":"","content":"

Action Statuses

  1. New - all new actions. Meaning: action is waiting for parent action
  2. WIP - work in progress. Only root actions for process started from WIP. WIP means the action is in work and we're waiting person or condition for moving next
  3. Waiting - !new status!, that status means that action is waiting for another process
  4. Done - was in progress and here was a solution (one conditions was matched or some person did transition)
  5. NADone - means, that action was stopped by some reason. All children move to NADone permanently. Notifications won't be sent
  6. Could be here \"Rejected\" status? For example for approval actions?

What kind of strategies do we want?

  1. From WIP to Done, children move to WIP
  2. From WIP to NADone, children move to NADone
  3. From WIP to New, parent moves to WIP (what should be with brothers?)
  4. From WIP to Done/Rejected (stop all actions) (something like hardstop request with cancelation all processes)

DataCollector and Expressions

We have \"expressions\" fucntionality. We're finding brackets and try to replace data there:

The line: [request.RequestId] will be replaced to EntryId of current request. 

Full dictionary:

Request Info: 

  • request.RequestId
  • request.Created
  • request.CaseOwner
  • request.Requestor
  • request.MainParameter
  • request.StartDate
  • request.EndDate
  • request.Created
  • request.Modified
  • request.Comment(the reason why request was rejected)

Request's Parent info:

  • request.parent.RequestId
  • request.parent.CaseOwner
  • request.parent...(all Request Info)

Request's Partner Info:

  • request.partner.PartnerID
  • request.partner.CommunicationName
  • request.partner.... (all partner's information)

Request's specialiization info:

  • request.spec... (all spec information)
  • request.spec.Name
  • request.spec.SpzCode

Request's contract info:

  • request.contract... (all contract information)
  • request.conract.Code
  • request.contract.CodeName

Request's Collected Data

  • request.data - complex object with ALL collected fields

Request's LNRContact info: 

  • request.LNRContact...(all contact info)

Other:

  • request.datenow - current DateTime

Action data:

  • action.SelectedPrimaryUser
  • action.SelectedBackupUser
  • action.ModifiedBy
  • action.StartDate
  • action.EndDate
  • action.Created
  • action.Modified

And DataCollector is a functionality to get some information from PBM or partner to request. For example, we'd like to have some files, or maybe additional information. We have several types:

  • string
  • file
  • LOV
  • Partner (or just one field)

Welcome to the start of the Scout Beta test!


To help get you started we have put together a list of knowledge base articles. They can be found here

Please use your NT credentials.


Areas to focus on

  1. Usability - Is the layout ergonomic? If not what can be improved
  2. Completeness - Are all the features you need, expect available in the tool
  3. Quality - Is the information presented accurate?
  4. Speed - How is the app performing. Please be sensitive that differentiate specific widget speed from the overall speed
  5. Regression - To ensure the key capabilities we need are still available in our new tool


You will find bellow a description of the pages as well as more useful information:


  • My Dashboard

Top section: this shows your quota, actuals and pipeline expected to ship this quarter (from BMI).

Total:

 1) Actual sellout- sellout QTD; 

2) Pipeline- expected to ship this Q

3) Linearity quota – quota expected to have been achieved QTD

4) Quota – official quota

My Dashboard – useful for identifying Partners with large predicted sellout; number of times they have been contacted in last 2Qs

Partner Coverage – pie chart displays breakdown of frequent vs non-frequent in your set. Bar chart below shows Coverage QTD, split by month.

NB: ensure quotas match official report, and that sellout matches official reports. Make sure Partner set is correct- raise any discrepancies using Support tool.

Comments: specific for MyDashboard- example comments would be – incorrect quota, pipeline comments, SPV. However, during beta please make all such notes in the Support tab


  • My Coverage

My Partner set: easy access to your own partner set.

Priorities table: this allows you to filter by Priority 1/2/3 and Called/to call (both Frequent and non-frequent) depending on focus. This then feeds into the Today’s Activities, and Sellout Performance history based on your focus for the day.

Today’s activities: 4 icons are Activation, Re-profiling, expiring Quotes, expiring OPGs.

Sellout Performance history- allows you to see last call outcome, date of last call, YoY, QoQ performance and more info. Clicking on a Partner takes you to their specific page.

NB: please ensure Partner set is correct (starting with number of Partners), please ensure PC/Print achievement are equal to percentages on My Dashboard.


  • Partner Details

1)      Activation:

Here we find information mirroring the ‘Predictive Analytics’ section of LuT. This data is highly useful for enhancing sales conversation pulling through from Tableau.

Key elements: QoQ performance, DR/RR split, Last Basket, Projected sellout

NB: please check data is proximate to known sales figures and inform of any errors.

2)      Pricing & Quotes:

Here you can access opportunities linked to the partner you are viewing, with the ability to drill down into details such as OPG number, authorised price, expiry date. You can also exclude deals from the pipeline here by clicking the ‘Exclude’ box and make opportunity-specific notes using the ‘notepad’ icon.

We can drill down even further into the OPG with a click, displaying SKUs present on the Deal ID, expiry date, MC code and more.

NB: please check if all Partner opps are linking through here, and that the deal data is correct.

3)      Comments:

Here you can see all notes relating to the Partner- if you create a comment elsewhere, please check here to see if it has been added successfully.

To see a list of all the known issues and new cr requirements, you will always find the most recent information in our debugger available here


Functionality

There are still some core capabilities being worked on. These include:

  1. Default ISR view when they first log in. At the moment the view is blank and ISRs need to manually select or reset each page.
  2. The update contact and partner capabilities are being tested end to end. The create new contact is still being developed.
  3. MyDashboard, MyActivities, MyCoverage notes can be seen by all
  4. Tableau reports - Issue with displaying non standard characters ie Russian
  5. My Coverage - Call Coverage section will be added during the Beta testing


 

Layout

  1. Although widgets can be resized, they have made for an initial specific design. The intent is to understand which widgets will realistically be resized and what dimensions to support. We have already the Call Outcome Comments being developed for a vertical approach as well as modifications to Master Data Partner and Contact widgets. 


Content


  1. Data quality: Country codes absent in ‘Phone’ section of ‘Business profile’
  2. Promotions still has only april data

3.Pricing widget: data not available for the following countries - to be added for V2 of SCOuT.

Albania 

Ghana 

Israel 

Macedonia 

Russian Federation 

Rwanda 

Serbia 

Ukraine 

4.Activation - Basket trend to be added during beta testing period
